acip: ,RTEN 'BREL GYIS BSDUS PA'I SHES BYA JI SNYED PA LA SGRIB PA'I NYON MONGS PA CAN MA YIN PA'I MI SHES PA RANG BZHIN MED PAR RTOGS PAS SEL BAR BYED PA BLO DE NYID SANGS RGYAS KYI SAR THABS GOMS PAS 'GYUR BAR BYED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: rten 'brel gyis bsdus pa'i shes bya ji snyed pa la sgrib pa'i nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i mi shes pa rang bzhin med par rtogs pas sel bar byed pa blo de nyid sangs rgyas kyi sar thabs goms pas 'gyur bar byed pa'i phyir
english: We use the realization that things have no nature of their own to clear away that form of not knowing things which is not involved with negative emotions-a state of mind which blocks us from seeing the total number of knowable things subsumed by dependence. This state of mind comes about at the level of a Buddha, when we have accustomed ourselves to the method side of things.
